scale: 0 absent, 1 mentioned without mechanism or uncommitted, 2 works but generic, 3 matches the reference architect's decision for the right reason, 4 also avoids the named known weakness

levels.3: Single-process Python app proportionate to one developer and a laptop; cost and time budget per run derived and enforced
levels.4: Also keeps observability/storage infrastructure minimal (no multi-service stack) while meeting story 8

levels.3: Deterministic code for CSV validation, arithmetic, snapshot and target selection; bounded specialist agents with per-agent tool/request budgets; synthesis step separated from tool use
levels.4: Also clean module boundaries (orchestrator, specialists, tools, contracts) rather than one agent module, and a degraded mode for weak/local models

levels.3: Retains original documents with hashes and provenance; extracted text; structured cited findings; citations validated against stored source IDs in code
levels.4: Also refreshes by source change (filing date/hash/ETag) rather than age alone, and versions the snapshot each view used

levels.3: Structured, closed-vocabulary research view (e.g. Add/Hold/Exit + confidence + positive and risk citations); code-level guard against advice-shaped output; CSV fields treated as untrusted (prompt injection)
levels.4: Also human-owned, versioned analysis lens that the model must test against its anti-thesis and cannot amend

levels.2: Some tests or an LLM judge
levels.3: Prompt, model and eval policy versioned together; repeated live evals for non-determinism; deterministic checks plus LLM judge; usable as a CI gate
levels.4: Also regression over stored traces without new model/search spend, and the judge model/rubric versioned

levels.3: Per-run budget arithmetic (calls, tokens) vs US$2 and 60 calls/min; usage limits per agent; caching to avoid repeat paid calls
levels.4: Also aggregates usage across stages and stops/degrades when the budget is reached

levels.3: Per-run trace of tool calls, results, tokens, cost and failures (e.g. OpenTelemetry), linked to the report
levels.4: Also retention defined and traces reusable as eval input

levels.3: Model provider switch by configuration; data providers behind an interface (MCP or adapter); new specialist or lens added without editing the orchestrator core
levels.4: Extension points only on named axes (provider, market, specialist, lens)

levels.3: Append-only ledger of views with horizon and resolution date computed in code; later graded against actual price moves

levels.2: Adds market or provider or versioning, not all
levels.3: Provider adapter for the second vendor with a normalised data model, market as configuration (exchange, currency, calendar), and every view stores prompt version, model, lens version and evidence snapshot IDs/hashes
levels.4: Also updates evals, cache and ledger consistently and makes past views replayable from stored traces/snapshots

penalties.name: Unjustified heavy infrastructure (Kubernetes, message bus, microservices, multi-service observability stack) for one developer on a laptop
LLM performs arithmetic, CSV parsing or orchestration that the design could do deterministically, without justification
Output can contain price targets/position sizing with no code-level guard
